probes.description: FORM P3-T5c stage 4: the trigger flow FollowUpNewShelf (it replaced the orchestration rule of the same name) runs on ShelfLayoutRegistered, published by the ShelfLayout CRUD create, and fires exactly ONCE: its createConcept step (WidgetSeedDemo, ifExists skip) inserts ONE row labelled with the new shelf's id (a double fire would show two), and its three scheduleEvent steps (ShelfCheckDueMs / ShelfCheckDueSeconds / ShelfCheckDueMinutes) each record a durable schedule carrying shelfId, due 120000 ms, 600 s and 60 min after the create -- a delay unit the runtime ignored would show as due now (or the record would be missing). Each schedule declares dedupeKey $input.id, so it is unique per shelf across executions. create and scheduleEvent need a DataSource, so this runs on the JDBC variant only (-StorageVariant h2local). GET /api/runtime/schedules is admin-only (the run's ADMIN key).

steps.name: the createConcept step inserted exactly one WidgetSeedDemo labelled with the shelf id
each scheduleEvent step recorded its own due time

probes.description: A durable schedule recorded under tenant dev (the FollowUpNewShelf flow, fired by this probe's ShelfLayout create) carries the shelf id in its payload. Another tenant (${key_othertenant}, tenant rep1probe-other, role USER) asking GET /api/runtime/schedules must be refused or shown only its own tenant's records: the shelf id must never appear in its response.

steps.name: the schedule exists for tenant dev
